description: Variant as chromosome:position:reference allele:alternative allele, GRCh38.
Target gene symbol. On trans rows (cis_trans = trans) it is the trans target gene.
AD locus name, numbered within this release (for example chr1_2).
dbSNP rsID of the variant; blank when the variant has none.
Chromosome number.
Position in base pairs, GRCh38.
Alternative allele of variant_ID.
cV2F variant-to-function score for the variant, from the score set built with xQTL features.

Highest AD-side inclusion probability for the variant across AD methods: the ColocBoost variant colocalization probability where present, otherwise the fine-mapping PIP, otherwise the coloc SNP PP.H4. On trans rows it is the trans fine-mapping PIP of the representative variant.
AD method that gave max_inclusion (for example single_gwas_finemapping or ADxQTL_coloc); trans_finemapping on trans rows.
Rank of cv2f_score among the variants of the AD locus; 1 is the highest score.
AD GWAS z-score with the largest absolute value across the GWAS studies that include the variant.
Two-sided p-value of max_zscore.
GWAS significance of min_pval: genome wide (below 5e-8), suggestive (below 1e-6) or ns.
-log10(min_pval).
AD GWAS studies whose results include the variant, separated by |.
One xQTL context for this variant and gene, as listed in the release workbook; all supporting contexts are in ordered_contexts. On trans rows, the context of the highest-PIP trans result.
Ensembl gene ID of the target gene.
Trans rows only: number of contexts in which this trans target gene was fine-mapped at this locus.
Trans rows only: those contexts, separated by |.

Evidence tier of the target gene, T1 to T6; blank when the gene has no tier, because it is linked only through trans evidence or its only evidence is quantile QTL, APOE or sex interaction QTL, or multi-gene fine-mapping. Tiers are assigned per gene across the whole release: a gene linked to several loci carries the same tier at each.
Genes with a trans fine-mapping effect from this variant, highest PIP first, separated by |. Describes the variant, so it repeats on every gene row of that variant.
Contexts of those trans fine-mapping effects, separated by |.
Widest credible-set coverage (cs50, cs70 or cs95) for each gene in trans_genes, in the same order.
Number of genes in trans_genes.
Number of contexts in trans_contexts.
Glycoprotein (gpQTL) trans targets of this variant, separated by |.
Contexts of those gpQTL trans effects.
Number of gpQTL trans targets.
Protein (pQTL) trans targets of this variant, separated by |.
Contexts of those pQTL trans effects.
Number of pQTL trans targets.
Single-nucleus RNA trans targets of this variant (single-gene trans analysis), separated by |.
Contexts of those snRNA trans effects.
Number of snRNA trans targets.
Trans hotspot gene modules linked to this variant, separated by |.
Contexts of those hotspot modules.
Number of hotspot modules in trans_hotspot_programs.
Number of transmap targets (distinct molecular events) for this variant.
Number of contexts with a transmap result for this variant.
Those transmap contexts, separated by |.
Variant position minus the target gene's transcription start site, in base pairs.
Variant position minus the target gene's transcription end site, in base pairs.
TRUE when the gene is TWAS significant: p below 2.5e-6 in the selected method, or in at least half of the methods. Blank means no significant TWAS record; it does not say whether TWAS was run.
TRUE when the gene passes MR: TWAS significant, cPIP above 0.5, at least 2 credible sets and I2 below 0.5.
TRUE when the gene is in the cTWAS results at PIP 0.75 or above.
TWAS z-score of the gene from the context with its smallest TWAS p-value.
The context that gave max_twas_z.
Rank of this variant among the gene's xQTL variants at the locus, by xQTL inclusion probability; 1 is the highest.

Largest xQTL inclusion probability for this variant and gene across contexts: the ColocBoost colocalization probability where present, otherwise the fine-mapping PIP. Blank when the pair's evidence carries neither (for example TWAS, quantile QTL or interaction results only).
Number of distinct xQTL contexts supporting this variant and gene.
Build bookkeeping: source of the locus and variant columns. Not shown in the explorer.

Every supporting context group for this variant and gene, best tier first, separated by ;. Each entry is the group label, the sign of the conditional effect (. when absent) and of the colocalization coefficient where present, then (tier, n = number of contexts).
TRUE when a supporting context of this variant and gene is astrocyte; blank when the pair has no context list.
TRUE when a supporting context of this variant and gene is bulk brain; blank when the pair has no context list.
TRUE when a supporting context of this variant and gene is bulk immune (monocyte, macrophage or microglia bulk); blank when the pair has no context list.
TRUE when a supporting context of this variant and gene is excitatory neuron; blank when the pair has no context list.
TRUE when a supporting context of this variant and gene is inhibitory neuron; blank when the pair has no context list.
TRUE when a supporting context of this variant and gene is microglia; blank when the pair has no context list.
TRUE when a supporting context of this variant and gene is oligodendrocyte; blank when the pair has no context list.
TRUE when a supporting context of this variant and gene is oligodendrocyte precursor cell; blank when the pair has no context list.
TRUE when the variant has any trans evidence (trans fine-mapping, pQTL, gpQTL, snRNA, hotspot or program results).
Build bookkeeping: source of the gene-level columns. Not shown in the explorer.
Build bookkeeping: source of top_confidence, or untiered. Not shown in the explorer.
